subject: RBAC activation logs + SCIM delta for SOC 2 evidence
messages:
From: Amanda Liu <amanda.liu@greenwayhealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 14:23:00 -0500
Subject: Request: RBAC snapshot & SCIM delta for SOC 2 evidence

Hi Jonas,

Hope you’re well. Our external auditor (TrustAudit) is running a SOC 2 fieldwork window next week and has asked for access-control evidence related to our integration with Redwood. Specifically they want: 

- A role snapshot showing all active RBAC roles and member counts as of 2026-11-10.
- SCIM delta export covering user provisioning activity for Sept–Nov 2026 (adds/updates/deletes).
- SAML assertion samples for administrative logins (redacted where appropriate).
- Activation logs for any just-in-time or elevated admin roles (start/stop timestamps + approver id).

Can you confirm whether you can provide these artifacts by COB 2026-11-14? If not, let us know the earliest feasible delivery date and any constraints. Auditor contact: audit@trustaudit.com.

Thanks,
Amanda Liu
Security Manager, Greenway Health
Attachment: SOC2_evidence_request.pdf (pdf)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Liu <amanda.liu@greenwayhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Request: RBAC snapshot & SCIM delta for SOC 2 evidence

Amanda — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Marissa (compliance) and Rishi (infra/ops) to scope artifacts.

Immediate notes:
- We can generate a role snapshot and SCIM delta export.
- SAML assertion samples we can provide with PII redacted; will include masked NameID and assertion IDs.
- Activation logs exist in the ops logging cluster; we’ll need to extract the JIT-elevation events and redact IPs per policy.

Target for delivery: we’ll aim to deliver a package by 2026-11-14 EOD but will surface any blockers by 2026-11-11 EOD.

Jonas Weber
Security & Compliance Program Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: none
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Liu <amanda.liu@greenwayhealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Request: RBAC snapshot & SCIM delta for SOC 2 evidence

Amanda — we can produce the following artifacts and delivery plan: 

1) RBAC role snapshot (CSV) — roles, grants, and member counts as of 2026-11-10. Filename: rbac_role_snapshot_20261110.csv
2) SCIM delta (JSON) — includes user create/update/delete events between 2026-09-01 and 2026-11-10. Filename: scim_delta_20261110.json
3) SAML assertion samples — 3 anonymized samples for admin flows. Filename: saml_assertions_sample.txt
4) Activation logs — JIT/elevation start & stop, approver id, reason (where supplied). We export logs as a zip containing CSV and syslog snippets. Filename: activation_logs_20261114.zip

Questions: 
- For activation windows, does the audit need raw timestamps or an aggregated view (e.g., average duration + outliers)?
- Please confirm whether redaction of IP addresses is required for the assertion samples.

We’ll stage the artifacts in a shared Drive folder and send the link plus a short manifest. If acceptable, we’ll deliver the initial bundle by 2026-11-14 and follow up with the raw logs within 24 hours.

Marissa Cole
Senior Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: evidence_manifest_template.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Amanda Liu <amanda.liu@greenwayhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, TrustAudit <audit@trustaudit.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 10:47:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Request: RBAC snapshot & SCIM delta for SOC 2 evidence

Thanks Marissa — the auditor prefers raw timestamps for activation events (start/stop) plus approver identity; aggregated views are OK as a supplemental artifact but not a substitute. IP redaction is fine for assertions, but please keep assertion IDs intact.

Also: can you include SCIM delivery logs for the initial onboarding batch in early Sept? We had a few deactivated accounts appear in the SCIM feed and TrustAudit wants the delta around those dates.

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Let me know if you need an alternate upload method (SFTP) for the larger log archive.

—Amanda
Security Manager, Greenway Health
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Liu <amanda.liu@greenwayhealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Request: RBAC snapshot & SCIM delta for SOC 2 evidence

Amanda — attaching the first bundle to the shared Drive link below. We included the raw activation event timestamps and approver user IDs (internal IDs only). IP addresses in SAML samples have been redacted per your guidance; assertion IDs preserved. SCIM delta includes the Sept onboarding window and a quick README describing the delta format.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1RBACEvidence
Delivered files (attached):
- rbac_role_snapshot_20261110.csv (CSV)
- scim_delta_20261110.json (JSON)
- saml_assertions_sample.txt (text)
- activation_logs_20261114.zip (zip, 42MB)

Notes/constraints: activation_logs_20261114.zip contains internal trace IDs; we can provide a crosswalk to user emails under an NDA if the auditor requires clear mapping. If TrustAudit wants SFTP for the archive, we can arrange credentials and a one-time link.

I’ll await confirmation that the artifacts are received and meet the auditor’s needs before sending any additional raw mappings.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Infrastructure Engineering Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachment: activation_logs_20261114.zip (zip)
